methods.name: Finite typed control-port affine BRC
capabilities: finite stable refinement from a supplied observer partition
methods.hard_boundary: Control state is typed non-spatial state. The caller must supply an observer-safe initial partition; hidden state, arbitrary infinite controls, unrecorded semantics and undeclared future operators are not preserved.

methods.name: Heartbeat six-channel environment symmetry quotient
capabilities: 13-class D6-invariant quotient of 64 binary six-channel masks
predictive detection of phase-addressed symmetry breaking
methods.hard_boundary: Diagnostic six positive-axis/channel mask only, not the full 12-direction Cell neighborhood. The 13-class result requires the declared D6-invariant observer and symmetry-safe future language; phase-addressed gates can require all 64 masks.
